extraction.pages_processed: 1-27 (whole document; pages 1-3, 26 and 27 carry only titles or are blank)
extraction.notes: Read in full. The document is the Agency's own plan, so targets and planned measures are interventions with proposed status, and the KPI rows are extracted as interventions with no value, because no initial or target value is given (page 20). Only KPI rows with a time frame for a named measure or a digital content are extracted; the many activity-count rows are left out as they add no claim. The SWOT table on pages 8 and 9 is treated as a summary table: where the running text makes the same claim, the running text item is kept and carries "also at page 8"; SWOT entries with no counterpart, or with a different strength of wording, are extracted with the flag table. Website and media mentions, general awareness-raising activities, and the opportunities that only restate goals are left out. No date of formal adoption is stated: the Strategy's status is `unclear`. The text contains internal tensions, which are recorded in item notes and not resolved: awareness has increased (page 7) against low awareness (page 8 and page 14); strong DPO cooperation against DPO isolation (page 8); close alignment with the EU acquis against the need for full GDPR transposition (pages 8 and 13). The action plan annex announced on page 11 is not in the text. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2).
